item: Re-vendor ENGINE_PIN.json to dfdf6fd (CAD join-miss + exemption_codes text[] fixes)
whatWasDone: Compiled packages/engine-core/src/parcel-record (hauska-engine, origin/main dfdf6fd0930b72d929f9a44834f9c33fb2d3eb75) with the exact pinned tsc invocation (--module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target ES2022 --lib ES2023,DOM), diffed the output against every currently-vendored .js file with diff --strip-trailing-cr, confirmed ONLY ingest-existing.js differs, copied it in, and bumped ENGINE_PIN.json's engineSha and note.
realFindingAlongTheWay: The prior pin was still 639855c (PARCEL-B-GATE-SCHED, PR #378) -- meaning PR #381's fix (widen stampText/isCadNullText for a real cad_property.exemption_codes text[]) had NEVER been vendored into hauska-factory either, despite an earlier 2026-09-04 sprint entry claiming that item closed and was live-probed against 500 real Caldwell parcels. That measurement did not reflect what hauska-factory actually serves. This re-vendor is the first time either PR #381's or PR #382's fix reaches served code. Flagging this because it's the same class of gap Wave 3's whole audit exists to catch (merged + tested != actually reaching production), just discovered one layer deeper than the audit itself went.
testEvidence: Fixed the three existing tests that asserted the now-reversed invariant ('a join miss must never reach absent-verified'), matching the new CadJoinMissBasis shape (no taxYear field). Added new coverage for exemptionCodes's text[] handling (real values, empty array, blanks-only array) and the landUseSource/acreageMethod stampAbsent siblings, since neither had ANY test coverage in this repo before -- both landing live for the first time via this same re-vendor. Full suite: 1003 pass / 0 fail / 2 pre-existing skips locally; one CI run hit the same pre-existing flaky timing-sensitive heartbeat test (test/p2-juris-57p01.test.mjs, unrelated file) seen earlier tonight -- confirmed flaky via a clean re-run before merging, not papered over.
nextStep: Per doc-repo-bd's own sequencing, the actual landUseCode re-run for item 20's remaining 4 counties (Hays/McLennan/Travis/Williamson) needs a real Cloud Run job with a proper timeout budget -- confirmed genuine Neon storage I/O latency, not query design or compute size. That job does not exist yet; working on it next, separately from this re-vendor.
